Progress and cancellation -> UploadExecutorTest::lifecycle, safeRetriesKeepPreparedBytesKeyAndOneRemoteObject and cancellationDuringBackoffCannotRestartOrCompleteANewerRun. Decision: retry is bounded to 3 attempts with 250/500 ms backoff, only for idempotent GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE or POST/PATCH carrying exactly one nonblank stable Idempotency-Key; never for unkeyed non-idempotent actions. Retries preserve the original prepared body, destination, credential values and key. safeRetriesKeepPreparedBytesKeyAndOneRemoteObject simulates lost response after publication and proves one object/one final URL across 2 attempts; exhaustedRetriesAreBoundedAndBackoffIncreases proves the limit; unsafeOrPermanentFailuresNeverRetry covers unkeyed/blank/duplicate-key requests and permanent/parse/oversized/auth/rate responses. abortObserversCannotOverwriteANewerRunOrEscapeAdmission proves cancellation/reentry ownership. Local preparation is not publication: UploadResponseTest::unresolvedPlaceholdersNeverPublishATruncatedUrl and UploadExecutorTest::attemptMetadataDoesNotInventPublicationAndLegacyReceiptsStayUnchanged prove missing/invalid result cannot create an output. Native optional upload_result.attempts is separate from the single publication URL; legacy receipts omit it. upload-executor-policy passes all socket-free production seam cases; upload-request, upload-response and destination-catalog pass.
